question: Compare CET1 ratio, leverage ratio and allowance to loans for New England banking organizations with $10B-$50B in assets, 2026Q2
headline: Three New England banking organizations with $10B-$50B in assets reported 2026Q2 CET1 ratios of 11.77% to 14.85%; Independent Bank Corp (MA) is highest on both capital ratios.
insights: Independent Bank Corp (MA) leads on capital: CET1 14.85% and leverage ratio 11.83%, against a group aggregate of 12.82% CET1 and 10.59% leverage.
Beacon Financial Corp is lowest on both capital measures (CET1 11.77%, leverage 9.83%). On allowance to loans it ranks second of three at 1.34%.

Eastern Bankshares Inc has the highest allowance to loans at 1.39%, above the group aggregate of 1.275%, while Independent Bank Corp (MA) is lowest at 1.06%. Allowance to loans has no better or worse direction, so it shows reserve cushion rather than a performance rank.
